# Indices: Flat Files API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-26 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

3 Flat Files endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Day Aggregates

`S3 /indices/day-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/indices/day-aggregates.md)

Candlestick data for a diverse set indices with daily open, high, low, and close values aggregated from all ticks throughout the day.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter–Advanced all

### Minute Aggregates

`S3 /indices/minute-aggregates` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/indices/minute-aggregates.md)

Candlestick data for a diverse set indices with minute-by-minute open, high, low, and close values aggregated from all ticks throughout the day.

- **Columns:** `close high low open ticker window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter–Advanced all

### Values

`S3 /indices/values` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/indices/values.md)

A daily record of tick-by-tick values for a comprehensive set of indices including S&P, Nasdaq, Dow Jones, and more as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `ticker timestamp value`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter–Advanced all
